content.title: 2019 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of acute pulmonary embolism (Reviewers)
content.summary_note: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during the period of development up to and including 2018).

declarations.category: B - Payment to department or institution / personal services
declarations.details: Speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member from healthcare industry. Novartis: heart failure (2018).
Ownership of shares of Orion Pharma, value of shares <1,000 EUR (2018).

Part-time employee in Satucon Inc. as a consultant cardiologist; description includes family members involved in clinical trials and estimated payments to Satucon Inc. from pharmaceutical companies (50-100 k €/year) (2018).

Institution (Heart Center, Kuopio University Hospital) involved in past and ongoing healthcare industry sponsored scientific studies; not directly involved as investigator except for PARADISE-MI study sponsored by Novartis (2018).
Direct personal payments (speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member) from healthcare industry. Actelion: CTEPH (2018); Bayer AG: CTEPH (2018).
Research funding under direct/personal responsibility (to department or institution) from healthcare industry. Bayer: pulmonary hypertension drug trial (2018).
